title: Titanium Flashlight Body
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400) is chosen for Titanium Flashlight Body where scratch resistance (hardness 36 HRC) and premium tactile feel differentiate the user experience. Its thermal conductivity (6.7 W/mK) is 85% lower than aluminum, reducing heat transfer to the skin surface in handheld devices. The alpha-beta microstructure enables thin-wall CNC profiling to <0.5mm wall thickness while maintaining structural rigidity under 3-point bending — essential for Premium EDC flashlight body tube. This rationale is driven by premium edc flashlight body tube and service environment demands.
process: CNC milling HSM 30k RPM for edc geometry
Tumble finish ceramic media with 0.5mm corner radius
PVD TiN/TiCN coating with 0.5mm corner radius
Optical Keyence inspection with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: PVD TiAlN coating (2-3um, HV2500 hardness) for scratch resistance and uniform gunmetal aesthetic finish — tailored for premium edc flashlight application
commonFailures: Wear-through of surface after 5000 insertion cycles - mitigated by PVD TiAlN 3um HV2500 coating — critical for premium edc flashlight performance

faq.q: What drop-test performance can I expect from Titanium Flashlight Body?
faq.a: Titanium Flashlight Body fabricated from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V with 0.8-1.2 mm wall thickness typically survives 1.5 m drop onto concrete (per IEC 60068-2-31) without permanent deformation when designed with ≤0.5 mm edge clearance to internal components. The 830 MPa yield strength provides a 3-5× safety margin over the impact stress for premium edc flashlight geometries.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Flashlight Body orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Flashlight Body is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Flashlight Body?
faq.a: Each Titanium Flashlight Body shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for premium edc flashlight.
